findings.title: Hook file exceeds the ~300-line guide and carries stale task-number comments
findings.description: The file is 366 lines, over the project's ~300-line target. Much of that is duplicated or stacked comment blocks. For example, two consecutive block comments sit above `series`: the "forwarding facade" one and the "Counter callbacks" one. The facade comment is orphaned and no longer describes the `useMemo` it precedes. Several comments also refer to build-process steps that mean nothing to a later reader. The header says "forwarding facade (task 14)" and "built up across tasks 8/10/12/14". The `teardown` comment says "subscriptions join here in task 12", but the subscription disposers are already implemented a few lines below it. Trim and reconcile these comments. The comment cleanup would likely bring the file closer to the limit.

findings.title: Visible-range translation is not re-applied when the first series is added
findings.description: The range effect reads `seriesCountRef.current`, a ref, and depends only on `[mount.ready, chart, range]`. If a consumer adds a series after the range is set, the effect does not re-run. The chart then keeps its default viewport until `range` changes, and the test `applies the range once a series exists` only passes because it calls `setRange` after `addSeries`. The code comment says initiative 120 will "activate" this seam. The gap will surface there as a silent mismatch between the Context and the chart. Either track the series count as state (or expose a signal) so the effect re-runs, or document this limitation explicitly at the seam.

findings.title: `measuredRect` and the measure-ref scaffolding are copy-pasted across four test files
findings.description: The `measuredRect()` helper, the `MEASURED` constant and the `measure` ref callback are repeated in the facade, errors, translation and resize suites. The resize suite inlines the same rect as a one-liner. `render-with-contexts.tsx` was introduced to avoid exactly this kind of divergence. Move the rect stub into `src/test/support/`.

findings.title: Imports are placed after a constant declaration in the translation test
findings.description: `LINE_SERIES` is declared between import statements, and `chart-provider-spy` and `render-with-contexts` are imported after it. This breaks the "sort imports" convention. Move the constant below all imports.

findings.title: E2E palette assertion assumes the token is a 6-digit hex
findings.description: `hexToRgba` parses `--color-surface` as `#rrggbb` and has no validation. If the token becomes a short hex, `rgb()`, `oklch` or any other format, `parseInt` yields `NaN`. The assertion then fails with an opaque `NaN,NaN,NaN,255` mismatch instead of naming the unsupported format. Assert the format, or throw an explicit error on a non-matching token.

findings.title: ESLint rule suppression is scoped and justified
findings.description: `react-hooks/refs` is disabled only for `use-chart-provider.ts`, with a clear rationale. Splitting the facade into `chart-facade.ts` was a sound way to limit the suppression's blast radius. Revisit it when the rule's false positive is fixed upstream.

findings.title: Harness gating uses direct MODE comparisons
findings.description: The direct `===` comparisons let Vite fold the condition at build time and tree-shake the harness route out of production. The comment explains this. The e2e build mode is wired consistently into `playwright.config.ts`.
